Comedian Dave Smith talks hyper-inflation and fractional reserve banking with Rogan in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Smith, a libertarian comic and podcaster, is the show's regular voice on money and the state. His act is half joke, half lecture, and this segment leans lecture.

He explains how banks create money by lending, and why he thinks the system quietly taxes savers through rising prices. Rogan asks what a normal person should do with savings in such a world. The segment is a plain-language brief for the hard-money view, from a comic who treats economics as a contact sport.
